mapper.sql: cgroups.id AS id, cgroups.name AS `name`, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM companies WHERE id IN (SELECT company_id FROM cgroup_companies WHERE cgroup_id = cgroups.id)) AS companies, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM price_types WHERE id IN (SELECT price_type_id FROM cgroup_price_types WHERE cgroup_id = cgroups.id)) AS priceTypes, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM egroups WHERE id IN (SELECT egroup_id FROM cgroup_egroups WHERE cgroup_id = cgroups.id)) AS employeeGroups, cgroups.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy
